name: 6-MAPDB
summary: 6-MAPDB, also known as 6-(2-(methylamino)propyl)-2,3-dihydrobenzofuran, is a chemical compound which may be an entactogen of the dihydrobenzofuran family. It is structurally related to drugs like 6-APDB and 6-MAPB, which have similar effects to MDMA and have been used as recreational drugs.
